dogecoin.text: Thanks to reddit and hashcat, I managed to recover the password to my long-lost (ca 2014) Dogecoin wallet, and found 6885 dogecoins inside! Now instead of FOMO about the current ridiculous bubble, I have anxiety about how to time my exit...

Note: I wrote the previous tweet just before I read the Coinbase news that gave Dogecoin a boost. Still not near the high I sold for, but I kept some coins in my paper wallet in case the hordes want to buy me an L lens too.
I just pulled the trigger on a professional-grade mirrorless camera (paid for by the good shibes who bought Dogecoin at $0.70 ... many sorry, not sorry)

@smdiehl As the dogecoin bubble inflated, I remembered that I received a few thousand dogecoins back in 2014. I managed to find my wallet and sell just before the crash.

People who paid $0.69/DOGE bought me a fancy new mirrorless camera. Many sorry, not sorry.
